[
  {"step":1,"file":"bin/fribidi-fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":32,"var":"data,size","code":"const FriBidiStrIndex str_len = size / 4; FriBidiChar *str = (FriBidiChar *) data;","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are reinterpreted as FriBidiChar input and the length is derived from the raw size."},
  {"step":2,"file":"bin/fribidi-fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":35,"var":"types,btypes,levels","code":"calloc(str_len, sizeof(...))","note":"The fuzzer allocates per-character metadata arrays that will be populated by the library."},
  {"step":3,"file":"bin/fribidi-fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":36,"var":"str,types","code":"fribidi_get_bidi_types(str, str_len, types);","note":"Raw input is classified into bidi types, producing the run data consumed by later resolution passes."},
  {"step":4,"file":"lib/fribidi-bidi.c","function":"fribidi_get_par_embedding_levels_ex","line":840,"var":"main_run_list","code":"compact_list (main_run_list);","note":"Adjacent runs are merged, which can free a run node while preserving links to neighboring isolate runs."},
  {"step":5,"file":"lib/fribidi-bidi.c","function":"fribidi_get_par_embedding_levels_ex","line":908,"var":"pp","code":"pp = merge_with_prev (pp);","note":"During weak-type resolution, a run is merged into its predecessor and the merged-away node is freed."},
  {"step":6,"file":"lib/fribidi-bidi.c","function":"merge_with_prev","line":85,"var":"second->next_isolate","code":"second->next_isolate->prev_isolate = second->prev_isolate;","note":"The merge updates isolate links through the soon-to-be-freed node, so stale isolate pointers can remain reachable from neighboring runs."},
  {"step":7,"file":"lib/fribidi-bidi.c","function":"merge_with_prev","line":96,"var":"second","code":"fribidi_free (second);","note":"The merged run node is freed, but later traversal may still follow pointers that were copied from or left pointing to it."},
  {"step":8,"file":"lib/fribidi-bidi.c","function":"fribidi_get_par_embedding_levels_ex","line":1037,"var":"main_run_list","code":"compact_neutrals (main_run_list);","note":"A later pass walks the same run list again, reusing isolate links that may now reference freed memory."},
  {"step":9,"file":"lib/fribidi-bidi.c","function":"get_adjacent_run","line":150,"var":"list->next_isolate / list->prev_isolate","code":"FriBidiRun *ppp = forward ? list->next_isolate : list->prev_isolate;","note":"Traversal dereferences the isolate-link field from a live run to obtain the next candidate run."},
  {"step":10,"file":"lib/fribidi-bidi.c","function":"get_adjacent_run","line":169,"var":"ppp","code":"ppp = forward ? ppp->next_isolate : ppp->prev_isolate;","note":"If the link chain reaches the freed node, the code reads through freed heap memory, triggering the use-after-free."}
]
